item.title: John Road Shooting, Eleuthera Runway, Canada Trade
item.ns0:title: John Road Shooting, Eleuthera Runway, Canada Trade
item.description:
Tonight on Our News, police launch an investigation into a deadly overnight shooting outside a John Road business that leaves one man dead and another critically injured. Officials inspect deteriorating runway conditions at North Eleuthera Airport following flight suspensions, while trade leaders share key outcomes from high-level talks in Canada aimed at expanding Bahamian exports. Meanwhile, the long-standing push for Freedom of Information reaches a new turning point, as nurses union leaders demand an urgent resolution to years of delayed promotions and unpaid back wages. Tune in for all these headlines, local sports updates, and your complete weather forecast.
